generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

technicalCriterionList.description: The intending Bidder shall be have successfully carried out Supply, erection & commissioning of HT line/Transformer of 11KV system /erection & commissioning of Transformer of 11KV & above system in any Central or State Govt. or PSUs or any reputed private organizations. In this regard, the intending bidder shall have successfully carried out the said work as Prime Contractor in a single Work done of value not less than Rs.27.74 lakhs in Central or State Govt. or PSUs or any reputed private organizations in last preceding five financial years and shall furnish copy of the related Work order and Work done/work completion certificate issued by the competent authority as documentary evidence. Cost of completed works of previous years will be given 10 percent of simple weightage per year to bring them to current year price level

technicalCriterionList.description: The Successful Bidder shall have Class-I or above (for Karnataka State)/ Class-A or above (other than Karnataka State) Electrical Contractor License. In this regard, the bidder shall furnish an undertaking as per KPCL format enclosed in the Tender document)
